945408.name: ybhP
945408.summary: It has been predicted through computational analysis of coevolutionary networks that YbhP may have a functional relationship with FliR, an integral membrane component of the flagellar export apparatus .  ybhP is up-regulated by RpoS in the presence of putrescine , down-regulated by LuxS at OD 2.4 in LB , and induced by acivicin treatment . [More information is available at EcoCyc: G6407].
